mode_policy: MIXED per council (spine-continuity review): opener band LIGHT, verdicts + cadence + banner DARK. 03 mirrors 01's light-dominant-with-dark-accents structure so it reads as the closing bookend around the all-light 02, not an all-dark slab; dark stays where the evidence pops (pills, Overdue red, banner outline). Both light + dark entries exist per tile, so mode is a one-field flip.

_notes.reconciled: Rebuilt from the authored draft into the real ResolutionsBento contract (theme-2 schema): tiles->images (light+dark split), src:{dark,light}->per-mode src strings, slot:band/ribbon->breakout, added measured aspect + focalPoint, {row,tiles}->CompRow[] with mode per entry. Crops renamed to <name>.png / <name>--dark.png.
_notes.no_crop: Every tile's aspect equals its native crop aspect (bands 5.11 and 5.76, standards 0.75=3:4), so nothing cover-crops; focalPoint is centered and inert.
_notes.off_page: 03-reports-table-light is a working-library resave only; not in images/composition.
